meta.name: creator-content-auditor
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "review this influencer content" or "check if this post meets brand guidelines"; runs the typed STAR pre-publish gate, scores Trust and Appeal on the deliverable, folds in the creator Suitability read, computes the profile-weighted SQS, checks the disclosure/claim/brand-safety and fraud/fake-engagement vetoes, and writes constructive revision feedback. Not for drafting the brief — use brief-generator; not for partnership terms — use contract-helper.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审核创作者内容是否符合品牌标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保创作者内容符合品牌指南和合规要求。
copy.tagline_en: Review creator content against brand guidelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure creator content meets brand guidelines and compliance.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照 STAR 框架审核创作者提交的内容，评估信任度、吸引力、适配性和回报，计算 SQS 分数，检查 FTC 披露、声明真实性、品牌安全和虚假互动，并给出修改反馈。
howto.when: 当用户要求审核创作者内容或检查帖子是否符合品牌指南时触发。

say.text: 审核这篇赞助视频和文案是否符合简报 v4 的转化目标。
检查这个帖子是否有正确的 FTC 披露声明。
say.note: Claude 会验证披露是否充分。

say.text: 评估这个创作者的适配性分数。
say.note: Claude 会调用 fit-scorer 读取适配性数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reviews influencer content using the STAR framework, scores Trust, Appeal, Suitability, and Return, computes the SQS, checks FTC disclosure, claim truth, brand safety, and fake engagement, and provides revision feedback.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to review influencer content or check if a post meets brand guidelines.

say_en.text: Review this sponsored video and caption against campaign brief v4 for conversion.
say_en.note: Claude runs the STAR gate and outputs SQS and revision notes.

say_en.text: Check if this post has proper FTC disclosure.

say_en.note: Claude calls fit-scorer for Suitability data.
